result.topic_en: Draft formulations for the opening of the theory of Abelian functions: an algebraic function s of z is defined by an irreducible polynomial equation F(s,z)=0 of degree n in s and m in z, and its branches are represented on a many-sheeted surface T spread over the z-plane, with branch points and rational functions of s and z.
